title: A stamp refusal names the unscanned file and its fix
why: Nothing told claude-sharables what to fix: the claim went red and was reverted with no line naming the cause or the fix.
note: Owner 15:16 CST Nov 11 (relayed by the coordinator): "i mean it's more like the repo had no way of knowing how to do that fix right? that's the real gap there wasn't a point/directive for it to get fixed". Incident: in ssemwal-cdc/claude-sharables PR 57, `merge 57 --confirm` made claim commit ca80aba83. It rewrote pending cites in plugins/*/skills/*/SKILL.md but not in plugins/_shared/skill-render-fidelity.block, which cite.scanGlobs lacks (actions/stamp/stamp.mjs rewriteCites reads only scanGlobs, default **/*.md). The shared-block check went red, and the claim was reverted with no line naming the cause or the fix. Ask: at --claim and --check, when a pending-cite match sits in a tracked text file outside cite.scanGlobs and excludeGlobs, the stamp refuses before it commits, names the file and line, and prints the exact fix: add "<the file's glob>" to cite.scanGlobs in .github/stamp.json, or to excludeGlobs if the text only teaches the syntax. A test goes red on today's code. Ties to step refusal-names-way-out. Waits for the fan-out (owner 13:51).
source: Owner feedback relayed 15:08 CST Nov 11; coordinator 15:10 CST
